title: Exploiting Cultural Biases via Homoglyphs in Text-to-Image Synthesis

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the influence of non-Latin homoglyphs on image generation using 'Relative Bias' (CLIP-based cosine similarity between generated images and explicit cultural prompts), 'VQA Score' (using BLIP-2 to ask if specific cultural characteristics are present in the images), and the Word Embedding Association Test (WEAT) applied to the models' text encoders.
